readme:
OpenBoss MCP

Remote MCP server for the public internet HP bar.

- Site: https://openboss.lol
- MCP: https://api.openboss.lol/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key)
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport http openboss https://api.openboss.lol/mcp`

Tools include get_boss, get_leaderboard, get_graveyard, get_pixel, smack_boss, create_checkout.
Agents can swing free smacks. They cannot complete payment. There is no pixel buy tool.

Official registry name: `io.github.flisko/openboss`
